custom_steps:
1. Open [WO-1] (Work Orders > All tab > Search "ZZAUTOTEST Edit WO Lead Mileage" > click the work order).
  2. There is no separate Edit Work Order window; the edits are made on the status card (the card at the left of the work order page that shows the status, Lead Technician, Mileage and Engine Hours).
  3. On the status card click Lead Technician and pick [Tech-B]. It saves at once.
  4. On the status card click Mileage, change it to 120500 and click outside the field (it saves when you leave it).
  5. Watch for any error message.
  6. Reload the page and read Lead Technician and Mileage on the status card.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Steps 3 to 5: both changes save with no error message.
  • Step 6: Lead Technician reads "Ralph Edwards" and Mileage reads 120,500. Both changes were saved.

Source — where this behaviour comes from

  • Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026, High 1; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08), §7; PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted. Source-verified 8 October 2026.
  • QA lead's ruling, 9 Oct 2026, in the QA session chat, given with screenshots after we reported that no Edit Work Order window opens for an existing work order. Part A, word for word: “For Lead technician. There are two places as appearing in the screenshots. The work order can not be edited directly, you edit their lines by navigating to the work order first and then by clicking each line on the work order. Yes the rest can be done from the cards appearing at the left on each work order. And Yes, ideally those checks use that card instead.” The steps were moved to the status card on 12 Oct 2026 under Rule 114(d).
